Implemented the null-safe date serialization fix in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/DefaultDateTypeAdapter.java`.

`DefaultDateTypeAdapter.write` now writes JSON `null` and returns when its `Date` value is null, preventing `SimpleDateFormat.format(null)` from throwing an NPE. This applies to custom date formats configured with `GsonBuilder.setDateFormat(...)`.
